TemplateInfo.Author: Microsoft
TemplateInfo.Description: A project template for creating an Aspire app with a Blazor web frontend and web API backend service, with optional Redis caching.
TemplateInfo.Name: Aspire Starter App (ASP.NET Core/Blazor)

Parameters.Name: name
Parameters.Description: The default name symbol
Parameters.Documentation: The default name symbol

Parameters.Name: Framework
Parameters.Description: The target framework for the project.
Parameters.Documentation: The target framework for the project.

Parameters.Name: UseRedisCache
Parameters.DisplayName: _Use Redis for caching (requires a supported container runtime)
Parameters.Description: Configures whether to setup the application to use Redis for caching. Requires a supported container runtime to run locally, see https://aka.ms/aspire/containers for more details.
Parameters.Documentation: Configures whether to setup the application to use Redis for caching. Requires a supported container runtime to run locally, see https://aka.ms/aspire/containers for more details.

Parameters.Name: TestFx
Parameters.Description: Configures whether to create a project for integration tests using the AppHost project.
Parameters.Documentation: Configures whether to create a project for integration tests using the AppHost project.

None.Description: Do not create a test project.

MSTest.Description: Creates an MSTest test project using the AppHost project.

NUnit.Description: Creates an NUnit test project using the AppHost project.

xUnit.net.Description: Creates an xUnit.net test project using the AppHost project.

Parameters.Name: XUnitVersion
Parameters.Description: The version of xUnit.net to use.
Parameters.Documentation: The version of xUnit.net to use.

v3mtp.Description: Chooses xUnit.net v3 with Microsoft Test Platform

Parameters.Name: appHostHttpPort
Parameters.Description: Port number to use for the HTTP endpoint in launchSettings.json of the AppHost project.
Parameters.Documentation: Port number to use for the HTTP endpoint in launchSettings.json of the AppHost project.

Parameters.Name: appHostOtlpHttpPort
Parameters.Description: Port number to use for the OTLP HTTP endpoint in launchSettings.json of the AppHost project.
Parameters.Documentation: Port number to use for the OTLP HTTP endpoint in launchSettings.json of the AppHost project.

Parameters.Name: appHostResourceHttpPort
Parameters.Description: Port number to use for the resource service HTTP endpoint in launchSettings.json of the AppHost project.
Parameters.Documentation: Port number to use for the resource service HTTP endpoint in launchSettings.json of the AppHost project.

Parameters.Name: appHostHttpsPort
Parameters.Description: Port number to use for the HTTPS endpoint in launchSettings.json of the AppHost project. This option is only applicable when the parameter no-https is not used.
Parameters.Documentation: Port number to use for the HTTPS endpoint in launchSettings.json of the AppHost project. This option is only applicable when the parameter no-https is not used.

Parameters.Name: appHostOtlpHttpsPort
Parameters.Description: Port number to use for the OTLP HTTPS endpoint in launchSettings.json of the AppHost project.
Parameters.Documentation: Port number to use for the OTLP HTTPS endpoint in launchSettings.json of the AppHost project.

Parameters.Name: appHostResourceHttpsPort
Parameters.Description: Port number to use for the resource service HTTPS endpoint in launchSettings.json of the AppHost project.
Parameters.Documentation: Port number to use for the resource service HTTPS endpoint in launchSettings.json of the AppHost project.

Parameters.Name: webHttpPort
Parameters.Description: Port number to use for the HTTP endpoint in launchSettings.json of the Web project.
Parameters.Documentation: Port number to use for the HTTP endpoint in launchSettings.json of the Web project.

Parameters.Name: webHttpsPort
Parameters.Description: Port number to use for the HTTPS endpoint in launchSettings.json of the Web project. This option is only applicable when the parameter no-https is not used.
Parameters.Documentation: Port number to use for the HTTPS endpoint in launchSettings.json of the Web project. This option is only applicable when the parameter no-https is not used.

Parameters.Name: apiServiceHttpPort
Parameters.Description: Port number to use for the HTTP endpoint in launchSettings.json of the ApiService project.
Parameters.Documentation: Port number to use for the HTTP endpoint in launchSettings.json of the ApiService project.

Parameters.Name: apiServiceHttpsPort
Parameters.Description: Port number to use for the HTTPS endpoint in launchSettings.json of the ApiService project. This option is only applicable when the parameter no-https is not used.
Parameters.Documentation: Port number to use for the HTTPS endpoint in launchSettings.json of the ApiService project. This option is only applicable when the parameter no-https is not used.

Parameters.Name: skipRestore
Parameters.Description: If specified, skips the automatic restore of the project on create.
Parameters.Documentation: If specified, skips the automatic restore of the project on create.

Parameters.Name: NoHttps
Parameters.Description: Whether to turn off HTTPS.
Parameters.Documentation: Whether to turn off HTTPS.

Parameters.Name: LocalhostTld
Parameters.DisplayName: Use the .dev.localhost TLD in the application URL
Parameters.Description: Whether to combine the project name with the .dev.localhost TLD in the application URL for local development, e.g. https://myapp.dev.localhost:12345. Supported on .NET 10 and later.
Parameters.Documentation: Whether to combine the project name with the .dev.localhost TLD in the application URL for local development, e.g. https://myapp.dev.localhost:12345. Supported on .NET 10 and later.
